integrated_answer.claim: Account-nested canned-response routes expose index/create/update/destroy. Controller creates and lists through Current.account.canned_responses; update/destroy find IDs through that relation. Strong parameters require canned_response, permitting short_code/content. Create/update render records; destroy returns head :ok.

Index renders a bare array. Search removes null bytes and binds ILIKE substring filtering across short_code/content. Sanitized CASE fragments rank shortcode prefix=1, shortcode substring=.5, content substring=.2 descending; LIKE wildcards are not explicitly escaped. Model requires content/short_code/account and shortcode uniqueness within account.

Server/client data shapes reconcile: actual CannedResponse overrides generic payload extraction with response.data, and cache-hit marshalling with {data:rows}. Refetch invokes extraction; valid nonempty cache invokes marshalling at L78. Generic defaults do not establish a canned-response shape bug.

Account-scoped URL derives from current pathname; dataManager reselects when that route account differs. get(false) uses network; get(true) checks account cache keys, refetches invalid/empty local data, and falls back to network if initial DB setup fails.

Request-spec source asserts bare-array/search/null-byte behavior and authenticated mutations. Cache-spec source uses doubles for account switching, network/cold/warm/changed-key reads, bare-array parity and unavailable IndexedDB. These are existing assertions, not passing test results.
